draft.emotion: quiet and relaxed, settling down after a long day
notes: Covers both 'evening' and the active part of 'night' (whereas 'η νύχτα' refers to late night or sleeping hours). Used directly as an adverb ('το βράδυ') to mean 'in the evening' or 'at night'.
It has an irregular genitive singular ('του βραδιού') and plural ('τα βράδια').

senses.definition: The part of the day from the end of the afternoon until people go to bed.
